title: Commercial Cleaning Beachhead Playbook
summary: Beachhead guidance for commercial cleaning buyer outreach (professional offices). Reference guidance only.
content_text: Prioritize single-tenant professional offices (law, accounting) in the local ring. Prefer reachable office managers/owners. Disqualify national multi-office firms when detectable. Do not treat this guidance as a fact about any specific company.

provenance.notes: Summarized from Anchor cleaning ICP operating notes.
